reactive-surfaces-implementation.description: The implemented S-REACTIVE-01/02/03/04 surfaces (resumable SSE client, research progress, cross-surface p95, degraded state) plus their Maestro e2e flows, reviewed by react-native-ui-reviewer
records: S-REACTIVE-01/02/03/04 are implemented and their .maestro/reactive/*.yml flows exist
holo seed:e2e --reset seeds the Streaming conversation, a research session, and a document
the reviewer runs every .maestro/reactive/*.yml flow on a named iOS Simulator

scenario.verification_service: review artifact inspection + Maestro flow runs

would_fail_if: disconnect — the review artifact is missing or incomplete
stub — verdicts omitted (only PASS, no FAIL/WARN possible)
empty — the Maestro flows were not run (verdicts not evidence-based)
mock — the artifact cites wrong task IDs or ACs
static — the artifact produced without running real e2e

steps: cite all 4 tasks and their ACs with verdicts

must_observe: the artifact cites the 4 task IDs `S-REACTIVE-01,02,03,04` (count `4`)
each verdict row includes `>=1` file path and the Maestro exit code
must_not_observe: the review artifact missing or empty (`0` bytes)
verdicts missing (a task list with `0` PASS/FAIL rows)
the artifact cites the wrong sprint/task IDs
the artifact omits one or more of the 4 tasks (count `<4`)

would_fail_if: disconnect — the Maestro streaming flow fails or exits non-zero
stub — duplicated tokens detected in the logs
empty — the flow not run (verdict based on code inspection only)
static — a T-SYNC-006 verdict PASS with no real e2e proof

steps: grep the logs for the duplicate-token count
verify the review artifact cites T-SYNC-006 PASS

must_observe: Maestro exit code `0` (the streaming flow passes)
the logs show `0` duplicated tokens after reconnect
must_not_observe: a verdict based on code inspection only (`0` real e2e runs)
